answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind identity to observable network behaviour instead of keys. Each agent must serve a live endpoint that a random set of mirrors probes at unpredictable intervals, and a nebula of aliases sharing one host collapses because the probes travel the same route with the same latency profile. An agent that hides behind a sable relay fails the route-diversity check, and standing accrues only while its endpoint answers fresh, non-replayable challenges. Mirroring external traffic is therefore unavoidable per identity.
